verdict: Yes, for a medical-device team. Pflow from Dhule pitched a disposable uroflowmetry system on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Urine-flow tests normally need expensive machines, so a disposable version helps small clinics offer the test.
angle: Urologists and clinics test urine flow to diagnose prostate and bladder problems. A disposable, low-cost device opens the test to more clinics. Each test uses a new unit, which gives recurring revenue.
